name: daily_brief
description: Runs Ofer's daily trading momentum brief (Fear & Greed + commodities + X + portfolio recommendations). Portfolio scope is a dynamic parameter: one or more agent portfolios (e.g. Classic OfersClaw5-PRIYN, Momentum-HHHGDTJ, or any subset). Live data only — no hardcoded portfolio numbers. Coordinate with Trader_Classic / Trader_momentum / eToro Account for ledger reads and X for tape. Deliver the full brief to the user; stop only after the Source line. Weekend = recs for next US session, no new opens. Never print secrets.
